name: How long does the home-buying process typically take in the Miami market?

mainEntity.name: How long does the home-buying process typically take in the Miami market?

acceptedAnswer.text: The home-buying process in Miami can vary but generally takes anywhere from 30 to 90 days from making an offer to closing, depending on financing, inspections, and negotiations. Cash offers or pre-approved mortgages can expedite the process, while unforeseen issues during inspection or title searches might extend it. Kelby Contreras advises clients to be pre-approved for a mortgage to streamline the search and offer stages, which can significantly shorten the overall timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The Miami home-buying process typically takes 30-90 days. Pre-approval for a mortgage can help expedite the timeline.
